MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Flex feels useful because it would let me add Alexa in a hallway without needing shelf space, giving it a purpose beyond duplicating my existing speakers.",
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a natural next step because it adds visitor alerts to my Alexa setup; my earlier door alarm purchase also makes home security a relevant interest."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV sticks repeat a need my recently purchased 4K Max bundle already covers, and a themed remote cover does not add a useful function for me.",
    "The older Dot and Show 5 feel redundant after my newer versions. A larger Show 8 or a Dot with a clock has some appeal, but neither gives me enough reason to add another device right now.",
    "The whole-home camera bundle goes beyond what I would choose now; I would try a doorbell before committing to several cameras."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to be treated as a reason to keep offering similar speakers and displays, even when they serve purposes I have already covered.",
    "My Fire TV purchase seems to suggest interest in any related streaming stick, although another version or decorative accessory does not address a new need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: buying a newer device makes an older version less useful, and buying a stand for my Show 5 suggests I am continuing to use that setup.",
    "I value additions that solve a distinct practical problem, such as seeing visitors or fitting Alexa into a hallway, more than another device with mostly overlapping functions.",
    "Interest in connected security does not mean I am ready for a whole-home bundle; starting with one useful device feels more appropriate."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa but often mistake a recently fulfilled need for a reason to buy another similar device."
}
